按住 1 秒，放開後等 1 秒。: Hold for 1 second, release, then wait 1 second.
不用寫腳本。選好按鍵、時間和執行方式，就能用群組快捷鍵控制。: No scripting needed. Choose the key, timing and run mode, then control the group with a hotkey.
連點適合重複點按；長壓會按住指定秒數，再放開。每個按鍵都能各自調整。: Repeat sends successive presses. Hold keeps a key down for the duration you set, then releases it. Adjust each key separately.
左鍵、右鍵都支援連點與長壓。游標放在哪裡，就從那個位置按下；AutoKey 不會: Left and right mouse buttons support repeated presses and holds. Each press uses the current cursor position; AutoKey does not move the cursor.
把同一用途的按鍵放進群組，設定自己的快捷鍵。再按一次就停止，也能在程式中停止全部: Group keys by task and assign a hotkey. Press it again to stop, or stop all groups from the app.
錄製的是單一按鍵或快捷鍵，不是整套操作。: Recording sets one key or hotkey, not a sequence of actions.
示範只在這個網頁播放，不會操作你的電腦。: The demos run only on this page and do not control your computer.

僅適用於允許自動化、且接受按鍵訊息的遊戲。此處不代表特定遊戲已通過測試。: Only for games that permit automation and accept key messages. This demo does not indicate that any specific game has been tested.
長壓 E 的採集示意: Gathering demo with E held down
按住 E，啟動採集裝置: Hold E to activate the gathering device
這個範例每半秒按一次滑鼠左鍵。AutoKey 使用每次按下時的游標位置，不會替你: This example clicks the left mouse button every half second. AutoKey uses the cursor position at each press; it does not move the mouse for you.
先把游標移到目標視窗內，再啟動。實際是否回應，仍取決於目標程式。: Move the cursor into the target window before starting. Whether it responds still depends on the target app.
把 PageDown 設成連點，依固定間隔翻閱內容。想停下來細看，再按一次群組快: Set PageDown to repeat at a fixed interval. Press the group hotkey again whenever you want to stop and read more closely.
適用於接受 PageDown 的閱讀或檢視工具。請先用單一按鍵確認反應。: For readers or viewers that accept PageDown. Test with a single key first to check the response.
選視窗。加按鍵。: Pick a window. Add a key.
在桌面程式裡完成這三步。設定會保存在本機，下次開啟後重新選擇目標即可。: Follow these three steps in the desktop app. Settings are saved locally; choose the target again when you next open it.
指定接收輸入的程式。先送出一個簡單按鍵，確認它有反應。: Choose the app that will receive input. Send a simple key press first to check that it responds.
加入按鍵與時間: Add a key and set the timing
建立群組，錄製要用的鍵。選連點或長壓，再設定時間和間隔。: Create a group and record the key you want to use. Choose repeat or hold, then set the duration and interval.
用快捷鍵開始、停止: Start and stop with a hotkey
選擇執行一次或循環，再設定群組快捷鍵。F8 只是例子，啟停鍵由你決定。: Choose run once or loop, then set the group hotkey. F8 is just an example; you choose your start/stop key.
AutoKey 會向指定視窗傳送按鍵訊息。顯示「執行中」，代表正在傳送，不代表對: AutoKey sends key messages to the selected window. “Running” means messages are being sent; it does not confirm that the app has received and acted on them.
先試一個鍵，再設定整組。: Test one key before setting up a group.
有些程式採用不同的輸入方式，即使視窗在前景也可能不接受。保持前景或提高權限，都無: Some apps use other input methods and may not accept messages even in the foreground. Keeping the app in front or raising permissions does not guarantee compatibility.
只有接受背景按鍵訊息的程式，才會在切換視窗後繼續回應。AutoKey 不會把焦點: Only apps that accept background key messages will keep responding after you switch windows. AutoKey does not take focus back.
群組內的按鍵同時起算。目前不支援依序輸出的動作或精確連招，多鍵組合效果也取決於目: Keys in a group start at the same time. Action sequences and precisely timed combos are not supported. Key combinations also depend on the target app.
兩個按鍵從同一時間開始的示意: Diagram of two keys starting at the same time
所有遊戲都能用嗎？: Does it work with every game?
不一定。遊戲必須允許自動化，並且能接收 AutoKey 傳送的按鍵訊息。本頁的採: Not necessarily. The game must permit automation and accept the key messages AutoKey sends. The gathering scene on this page is an original animation, not evidence of compatibility with any specific game.
可以錄製一整套操作嗎？: Can I record a full sequence of actions?
目前錄製功能用來設定單一鍵盤鍵、滑鼠左／右鍵，或群組快捷鍵，不會記錄一整段操作。: Recording currently sets a single keyboard key, left or right mouse button, or group hotkey. It does not capture a sequence of actions. Keys in a group start together, not in list order.
滑鼠會自己移到指定位置嗎？: Does the mouse move to a set position?
不會。每次按下都使用當下的游標位置，放開時沿用該次按下位置。啟動前請把游標移到目: No. Each press uses the current cursor position, and release uses that same position. Move the cursor into the target window before starting; input outside the window may be ignored.
設定會保存、跨電腦同步嗎？: Are settings saved and synced across computers?
群組與語言偏好會保存在本機。首發版本不提供 Steam Cloud，也不會自動跨: Groups and language preferences are saved locally. Steam Cloud is not included at launch, and settings do not sync automatically across computers. Back up your settings before switching computers. Select the target window again when you reopen the app.
桌面程式有哪些語言？: Which languages does the desktop app support?
桌面介面支援 31 種語言。預設跟隨 Windows 顯示語言，沒有對應時使用英: The desktop interface supports 31 languages. By default, it follows the Windows display language, with English as the fallback. You can also choose manually. This website is available in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.
